newsitem.title: POLAND: NBP DRAINS PLN 144 MLN FROM POLISH MONEY MARKET.
newsitem.headline: NBP DRAINS PLN 144 MLN FROM POLISH MONEY MARKET.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland drained 144 million zlotys from the market through a reverse NBP-bill repurchase auction after banks bid to place 144 million with the central bank, the NBP said.
The bank drained the market for seven days at a maximum rate of 21.63 percent, up from 21.55 percent on the last such auction on December 20, 1996.
The bank drained the market for 14 days at an unchanged maximum rate of 21.64 percent.
